### Convert JSON data to data frame

```{r}

# --- Read the JSON file ---
json_data <- jsonlite::fromJSON("Images.json", simplifyVector = FALSE)

# --- Helper to parse the _id field ---
parse_id <- function(id) {
  id <- sub("\\.png$", "", id)          # drop ".png"
  parts <- strsplit(id, "_")[[1]]       # e.g. c("NAR","76000172","page","2")
  
  list(
    form_type  = parts[1],
    patient_id = parts[2],
    page       = parts[length(parts)]   # last element = page number
  )
}

# --- Flatten each record into long format ---
gold_standard_dataset <- purrr::map_dfr(json_data, function(rec) {
  id_info <- parse_id(rec[["_id"]])
  fields  <- rec[names(rec) != "_id"]   # everything except _id
  
  tibble::tibble(
    hospital   = substr(id_info$patient_id, 1, 2),
    patient_id = id_info$patient_id,
    form_type  = id_info$form_type,
    page       = id_info$page,
    field      = names(fields),
    value      = vapply(
      fields,
      function(x) if (is.null(x)) NA_character_ else as.character(x),
      character(1)
    )
  )
})

gold_standard_dataset <- gold_standard_dataset |>
  dplyr::filter(field != 'hospital') |>
  dplyr::filter(!grepl("\\?|@", value))
  

write.csv(gold_standard_dataset, "gold_standard_dataset.csv", row.names = F)

# --- Result ---
head(gold_standard_dataset)

```
